_heapMB_note: 2026-08-06, ISOLATED: the run-to-run swing in this gate's heap is the --use-gl=angle REAL-GPU FLAG, not garbage collection, not the deployed bundle, and not the legacy streamall path (all three were suspected and fixed or ruled out first). Same probe, same deployed URL, same district, WITHOUT the flag: 228/228/228 MB, twice, exactly stable. WITH it: 307, 326, 347, 391, 415 on unchanged worlds (1223k tris and 313 draws identical). Forcing gc() removed one source of noise and could never remove this one. KEEP the flag — a real GPU is what a player has, so the higher figure is the honest one — but that makes any tight threshold flap. 460 sits above the observed maximum deliberately. The stable software-raster figure is 228MB; the ~206MB iOS ceiling should be judged against THAT plus whatever the GPU path genuinely costs, which is the open question.
